title: Alarm Configuration
description: Alarm types and alarms of the AlarmDetector (config.toml input_files.alarms_file). A configured id raises an event each time its state changes, on the GameMaster side (ActualMeasurement) and on the SCADA side (MeasurementReceived, per destination); controls raise command events.

color.description: Display colour, e.g. grey, blue, yellow, red, violet (interpreted by Argus)

sound.description: Sound played until the alarm is acknowledged, e.g. grey, blue, yellow, red, violet (interpreted by Argus); null for no sound

label.description: State displayed after the alarm label, e.g. Open

priority.description: Priority, also giving the colour and the sound through 'priorities' unless set here

alarm.description: Overrides the 'alarm' of the type for this state

name.description: Level name, key of the 'thresholds' of the alarms of this type

direction.description: high (default): crossed when the absolute value is above the threshold. low: when below it, but not zero (e.g. a de-energised bus)

label.description: State displayed after the alarm label, e.g. Limit 1 overload

priorities.description: Colour and sound from the priority: the rule with the highest 'min' not above the priority applies

types.description: Alarm types by name. A type has either 'states' (state change of the value) or 'levels' (threshold crossing of the absolute value)

alarm.description: True (default) to show the events in the alarm list, false for the event list only

mode.description: momentary (default): acknowledging removes the alarm. persistent: the alarm must be acknowledged then cleared, once back to normal; also raised at start when not normal

retain.description: True (default): one alarm per occurrence. False (NO RETAIN): only the latest state of each id is kept

normal.description: Normal value (state types), required for persistent types

states.description: State of each value, keyed by the value (integers without decimals, e.g. '1'). Other values are displayed as is

levels.description: Threshold levels, the levels of each direction in increasing severity (increasing threshold for high levels, decreasing for low levels). The state is the last level crossed

normal_state.description: State when no threshold is crossed (threshold types)

hysteresis.description: Relative hysteresis to leave a level, e.g. 0.02: a high level is left below 98% of its threshold, a low level above 102%

commands.description: Command events (ControlSent: all of them on the GameMaster side, those from the HMI on the SCADA side)

label.description: State displayed before the value, e.g. Command

tase2.description: Tase2 id, resolved to the id through scada_outputs_file, instead of 'id'

label.description: Displayed name, defaults to the id

equipment_id.description: IIDM equipment, located in the network of each backend by Locate (with side)

substation_id.description: IIDM substation opened by Locate, when the equipment is not given or not found in the network of a backend

side.description: Side of the equipment (branch, 3 windings transformer) located by Locate, side ONE if not given

thresholds.description: Threshold of each level name of the type (threshold types); a level without threshold is never crossed
